interpretation: Article 45 is a general/default rule for services to a non-taxable person. The current consolidated text expressly contains supplier fixed-establishment and fallback branches. This candidate requires an explicit review that no relevant supplier fixed establishment changes the supplier location, plus an explicit general-service classification and exception screen. It cannot match electronic, consultancy, mixed or other specifically classified services. Hungarian NAV guidance supports Áfa tv. 37(2); the exact current NJT primary text was not directly retrievable and is marked unverified.
